sections.section_title: DCMIPP Pipe0 current pixel packer Memory0 address register 2 (DCMIPP_P0CPPM0AR2)
sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.39 "DCMIPP Pipe0 current pixel packer Memory0 address register 2 (DCMIPP_P0CPPM0AR2)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1931.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x7C8
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 M0A[31:0]: Memory0 address
Base address of the current memory area 0, to whom data are written. It is assumed to be a
multiple of 16, hence its bits 3:0 are always at 0x0.
